description_en: The apartment is located on the second residential floor of one of the newest and quality complexes in the Porcelani area, on Xhanfize Keko Street. The complex is expected to be completed by the middle of 2026. It has a total area of ​​99.97 M2 and a net area of ​​86.98 M2. For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
